title: UTMB Live — Paraty Brazil by UTMB 2026, PTR 108
claims: The 2026 Paraty Brazil by UTMB was held on 17–20 September 2026; the PTR 108 started on 18 September at 19:00 and recorded 285 starters, 61 DNF and 224 finishers.
The 2026 PTR 108 live header listed 67.1 miles (108 km nominal), 15,912 ft+ and 3 Running Stones.
The 2026 PTR 108 top three men were Rogério Silvestrin, Rodrigo Machado Oliveira and Paulo Galvao; the top three women were Juliana Stolarski Uavnizack, Mariana Scarpelli and Lilian Schiffer.
